resume: Family or social housing allowance: who is entitled, the documents to prepare (including the rent certificate signed by the landlord) and applying to the Caf after a separation.
aQuoiCaSert: Housing benefits reduce the amount of rent you pay. With children or family benefits, the one that applies to you is usually the ALF (allocation de logement familiale, family housing allowance); otherwise the ALS (allocation de logement sociale, social housing allowance). After a separation, each parent who takes a home can make their own application to the Caf (Caisse d'allocations familiales, the family benefits office), calculated on their own income and new family situation only.
quiEstConcerne: Tenants or subtenants of decent housing occupied as their main residence.
ALF: in particular people who receive family benefits or the AEEH (disabled child education allowance), or who have a dependent child under 21, or single pregnant women under certain conditions.
ALS: people who meet neither the conditions for the APL (aide personnalisée au logement, personalized housing aid) nor those for the ALF.
Foreign nationals must hold a valid residence permit.
aSavoir: APL, ALF and ALS cannot be combined. The amount depends on your income over the last 12 months, your assets (above €30,000), your rent, your family situation and where the home is: only the Caf simulator gives an estimate.
A subtenant must not be related to the main tenant or the landlord.
The benefit is paid on the 5th of each month. Entitlement starts on the 1st day of the month after your file is processed, and the first payment can take about 2 months: apply as soon as you move in.
If refused, you have 2 months from the notice to refer the matter to the Caf's amicable appeals committee (commission de recours amiable).
Separation: report it to the Caf. Each parent declares their own home and their own family situation; the amount is recalculated accordingly.

documents.libelle: Rent certificate (cerfa n° 10842), dated and signed by the landlord
documents.detail: Download it and have it completed by your landlord or social housing provider. Without their signature, the file is incomplete.
Copy. It states the rent, service charges and move-in date.

documents.detail: Payslips, allowances, child support received or paid: you will be asked for them in the online form.

documents.libelle: Judgment or agreement setting the children's residence, if you have one
documents.detail: Copy. Useful if the Caf asks you to prove where the children live after the separation.
Keep it: it shows the amount and the start date of the entitlement.

aConfirmer: To be confirmed locally: in the overseas departments, the APL reportedly does not apply to ordinary housing (only to certain residential facilities, logements-foyers). For ordinary housing, it would be the ALF or ALS. Check with the Caf de la Guadeloupe.
To be confirmed locally: the scales specific to overseas France. Use the Caf simulator rather than an indicative amount.
How the Caf divides the child between the two households under shared residence for housing benefit is not detailed in the pages consulted: ask the Caf de la Guadeloupe.
Saint-Martin and Saint-Barthélemy are separate territories (collectivités): check with the Caf which rules apply if your home is there.
